remarks:
*Open House Saturday, October 10th from 1:00 – 3:00PM*  Welcome to this gorgeous 2024 built ranch-style home, situated in peaceful country setting just 
outside of Arcade Village but with the luxury of village amenities, including Arcade electric! This 
well-designed 3-bedroom, 2 full bath residence offers open-concept living. Enter the house 
through the lavish front covered patio. As you step inside, you’ll immediately notice the spacious 
and inviting layout. The heart of the home features an open floor plan that seamlessly connects 
the kitchen, dining area, and living room, making it perfect for both everyday living and 
entertaining. The kitchen boasts a striking backsplash, a large island, modern finishes, and ample 
cabinet space, while the adjoining living room is highlighted by an electric fireplace for year-round comfort and ambiance. You will be awed by the primary suite which includes an adjoining 
bathroom with double sink vanity, a large step-in shower, a luxurious soaking tub, and a huge,
customized walk-in closet. Additionally, there are two nice-sized guest bedrooms each with 
custom closets. Step out the sliding glass doors to the fenced back yard. Additional features 
include a spacious attached two-car garage with epoxy floor. In floor heating in the house and 
garage. A heated custom shed with electric and a second shed with lean-to offer extra space for 
storage or possibly a home office. There’s also a 50 amp electric service by the shed. Security 
cameras convey. Custom-made furnishings, kitchen appliances, washer, dryer, and garage 
cabinets are all negotiable. This very unique home combines rural charm with state of the art 
amenities.
